svg.title: AI asked for unit tests vs. AI powered by Satori
svg.desc: A 35-second loop. An AI writes unit tests that pass, but pulling back reveals a type error and a vulnerable dependency outside the tested area. Satori scans the repository, detects the stack and tools, and generates a .satori.yml playbook with Tests, Lint, Formatting, Types and Security lanes. The run surfaces two findings; the AI fixes them and reruns the playbook until all five checks pass.

svg.text: But passing tests only tell you about the behavior they cover.
